# Noto Sans SC UI font

Source: Google Fonts, Noto Sans SC (official Google Fonts CSS API).
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see NOTO_SANS_SC_LICENSE.txt.

Self-hosted heading weight 600, with 795 glyph characters requested for the public static interface, Latin/Greek and common mathematical punctuation. Other text falls back to the Chinese-capable system stack. The website makes no external font request.
